title: MVICAD2: Multi-View Independent Component Analysis with Delays and Dilations
gist: MVICAD2 extends multi-view ICA so that shared brain sources can differ across subjects by both temporal delays and dilations, with identifiable sources and a closed-form likelihood approximation. It beats existing multi-view ICA methods in simulation and, on the Cam-CAN MEG dataset, links the recovered delays and dilations to aging.

insights.claim: Multi-View Independent Component Analysis (MVICA) assumes identical brain sources across subjects, an assumption the authors argue is too restrictive because of individual variability and age-related changes.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: The identical-source assumption is the weak link this paper targets; loosening it is what justifies the new model.
insights.quote: Common methods, such as Multi-View Independent Component Analysis (MVICA), assume identical sources across subjects, but this assumption is often too restrictive due to individual variability and age-related changes.
insights.locator: Machine learning techniques in multi-view settings

insights.claim: MVICA with Delays (MVICAD) lets sources differ up to a temporal delay, but the authors say temporal dilation effects common in brain dynamics (particularly for auditory stimuli) make estimating time delays alone insufficient.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
entities: Multi-View Independent Component Analysis with Delays
insights.so_what: Motivates adding dilations as a second degree of freedom rather than delays only.
insights.quote: temporal dilation effects, particularly in auditory stimuli, are common in brain dynamics, making the estimation of time delays alone insufficient
insights.locator: Multi-View Independent Component Analysis with Delays (MVICAD) addresses this

insights.claim: MVICAD2 (Multi-View ICA with Delays and Dilations) allows shared sources to differ across subjects in both temporal delays and dilations, and is presented as a model with identifiable sources plus a closed-form approximation of its likelihood.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
entities: Multi-View Independent Component Analysis with Delays and Dilations
insights.so_what: Identifiability plus a closed-form likelihood approximation is what makes the richer delay-and-dilation model tractable to fit.
insights.quote: We present a model with identifiable sources, derive an approximation of its likelihood in closed form, and use regularization and optimization techniques to enhance performance.
insights.locator: To address this, we propose Multi-View Independent Component Analysis with Delays and Dilations

insights.claim: In simulations, MVICAD2 is reported to outperform existing multi-view ICA methods.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Simulation superiority is the core empirical claim supporting the method over MVICA/MVICAD baselines.
insights.quote: Through simulations, we demonstrate that MVICAD2 outperforms existing multi-view ICA methods.

insights.claim: On the Cam-CAN dataset, MVICAD2's recovered delays and dilations are shown to be related to aging, validating the method on real MEG data.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Tying delay/dilation parameters to age is the neuroscience payoff and a hook for aging-related brain studies.
insights.quote: We further validate its effectiveness using the Cam-CAN dataset, and showing how delays and dilations are related to aging.
insights.locator: We further validate its effectiveness using the Cam-CAN dataset
